verdict.rationale: The xAI API exposes explicitly versioned model identifiers (grok-4.6, grok-4.5, grok-imagine-image-2.0) and a release-notes changelog. One release note shows a model slug being transparently re-routed to a newer version without changing the request or response shape, which suggests some managed version transition. However, nothing in the pack documents a formal deprecation policy, such as notice periods, sunset dates or lifecycle commitments, or API-level versioning beyond model names. missing for 10: a documented deprecation/sunset policy with notice timelines, explicit API (endpoint) versioning scheme, independent corroboration of version stability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: Requests to the slug will be served by grok-imagine-image-2.0 with quality set to low, with no change to the request or response shape
